output.summary: Source inspection supports bounded push-only Flatpak building, bundle installation/runtime commands, and protected manual VAAPI/NVENC matrix logic with exact encoder and no-fallback checks. The manifest-parity failure is a material CI defect.
material_defects: [BLOCKER] .github/workflows/ci.yml:73 compares the release and CI Flatpak manifests, but packaging/flatpak/io.github.stranmor.MediaStudio.yml includes --filesystem=xdg-data/kio while the CI manifest omits it. The packaging job therefore aborts on every run; add the missing finish argument to the CI manifest (preferred) or deliberately revise the parity contract.

No hardware-matrix run logs or evidence of provisioned trusted runners were supplied.
